accepted_recoveries: Change the hostname anti-affinity rule from required to preferred for this workload.
Use a satisfiable topology domain that preserves intended spreading when such topology is present and evidenced.
forbidden_actions: Do not delete healthy replicas to hide the unavailable replica.
Do not reduce desired replicas below the benchmark requirement.
Do not alter scheduler policy cluster-wide.
incident.injected_fault: A three-replica recommendations Deployment requires hostname-level pod anti-affinity in a two-node worker pool, leaving the final replica permanently unschedulable.
observable_signals: FailedScheduling events report that required pod anti-affinity rules cannot be satisfied.
Available nodes have adequate CPU and memory but already host matching replicas.
preconditions: Exactly two worker nodes are eligible for recommendations pods.
The Deployment requires three ready replicas for the test SLO.
Both eligible nodes have capacity for an additional replica.
required_evidence: Capture desired, ready, and unavailable replica counts.
Capture the required podAntiAffinity rule and topology key.
Capture matching pod placement across eligible nodes.
Demonstrate that resource pressure and taints are not the scheduling cause.

hypotheses.cause: Hard pod anti-affinity (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) with topologyKey 'kubernetes.io/hostname' prevents scheduling more than one replica of recommendations-api on the single available node vm-4.
supports: Deployment recommendations-api specifies podAntiAffinity with requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution matching label app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendations-api on topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname.
Pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-wrlsb is already scheduled and running on node vm-4 with the matching label.
Pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-wpdpc is Pending with FailedScheduling event: '0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match pod anti-affinity rules.'
Node vm-4 has adequate allocatable resources (4 CPU, 16Gi memory) and no MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, or PIDPressure conditions.

hypotheses.cause: Node vm-4 lacks sufficient allocatable CPU or memory capacity to host an additional recommendations-api pod.
contradicts: FailedScheduling event explicitly states '1 node(s) didn't match pod anti-affinity rules' rather than 'Insufficient cpu' or 'Insufficient memory'.
Pod request is minimal (20m CPU, 16Mi memory) while node vm-4 reports 4 allocatable CPU and ~16Gi allocatable memory with MemoryPressure=False.
supports: Pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-wpdpc remains in Pending status.

contradicts: FailedScheduling event does not report untolerated taints.

supports: Pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-wpdpc cannot be scheduled to node vm-4.

payload.rationale: The deployment recommendations-api specifies a hard pod anti-affinity rule (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) on topologyKey 'kubernetes.io/hostname'. With only node vm-4 available to host the pods, the second replica is blocked in Pending state due to FailedScheduling. Converting the anti-affinity rule to preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution satisfies the scheduling constraints on the available node while preserving soft spreading intent.
payload.rollback_trigger: The recommendations-api deployment fails to schedule replicas or encounters increased error rates exceeding the SLO threshold after applying the anti-affinity patch.

success_criteria.description: All replicas of recommendations-api deployment become scheduled, running, and ready, satisfying the minimum availability requirement and meeting the SLO.
